title: 第21章 聊着天就把最难的一关给过了第22章 下一个十年计划
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
“假的吧！”
云鼎很酸。
“没想到，今年收获最大的是无道师兄。”
云千刃也是酸的很。
“无道师兄今天不仅收了一位七品灵根的小丫头，现在又收了一位极品灵根的小家伙，真是让人羡慕。”
红娘同样酸的很。
其实她很喜欢神仙儿。
且神仙儿来自己的缥缈峰也理所应当。
但谁能想到。
叶青青没有成功，却被那杜明小子用七彩苏糕忽悠走，简直无语。
无道缓缓睁开双眼。
“大家皆为落仙宗弟子，我的弟子，便是各位的弟子，还请各位日后多多照顾。”
无道难得说出这么多话。
一来，他收了两位超级天才，的确有些过分，虽然很爽。
二来，他在提醒几人，落仙宗是一个整体，内部摩擦可以有，但绝对不可以敌视，那对一个宗门来说是毁灭性的。
“无道说的没错。”云阳子语气严肃。
“各位，你们都知道极品灵根为何物，对落仙宗意味着什么，所以，我希望在郑拓没崛起之前，这个消息不要声张，以免惹来不必要的麻烦。”
“师兄所言极是。”
云鼎收起玩笑附和道。
“魔族突然出现在宗门附近绝非偶然，加上今年天才成井喷式爆发，我有预感，未来怕是会有大事发生，你我最好早做打算。”

红娘懂得演算之术。
本能的，捕捉到一角未来。
几人互相看看。
也是这种想法。
若有人知道落仙宗有弟子身怀极品灵根，怕是会引来祸端。
面对那些超级宗门，落仙宗怕是都不如人家一峰来的强大。
“如今郑拓师侄入了无道师兄门下也好，逃得一丝喧闹。”
云千里也是这个想法。
“郑拓。”云阳子郑重开口道：“想来你也是聪明之辈，极品灵根，世所罕有，若被贼人知道，你将有生命危险，所以，在你未能达到元婴之时，万万不可暴露极品灵根之事，你能否做到。”
“弟子明白。”
不用云阳子说，郑拓早就有这个想法。
若非他实力不够，怕是会逼着在场几人发毒誓不泄露此事。
“散了吧。”
云阳子挥手。
云鼎，云千里，红娘，雷刑，四人离去。
无道欲带郑拓离开。
“师父，等等！”
郑拓叫住无道，看向云阳子。
“内个……宗主，你好像说过，我要是能把古铜宝镜弄坏，你就送给我，是吧。”
content_en:
"Fake it!"
Yunding is very sour.
"Unexpectedly, the one who gained the most this year was Senior Brother Wudao."
Yun Qianren was also very sore.
"Senior Brother Wudao not only took in a little girl with a seventh-grade spiritual root today, but now he also took in a little guy with a top-grade spiritual root. It's really enviable."
The matchmaker was also very sour.
In fact, she likes Shenxian'er very much.
And it is natural for the gods to come to their Piaomiao Peak.
But who would have thought.
Ye Qingqing didn't succeed, but was fooled away by Du Ming with colorful cakes. He was speechless.
Wu Dao slowly opened his eyes.
"We are all disciples of Luo Xian Sect. My disciples are your disciples. Please take good care of me in the future."
It's rare for Wu Dao to say so many words.
First, he accepted two super geniuses, which was indeed a bit excessive, although it was very satisfying.
Secondly, he was reminding a few people that Luo Xian Sect is a whole. There can be internal friction, but there must be no hostility. That would be devastating to a sect.
"Wudao is right." Yunyangzi said in a serious tone.
"Everyone, you all know what the best spiritual root is and what it means to Luo Xian Sect. Therefore, I hope that this news will not be made public before Zheng Tuo rises, so as not to cause unnecessary trouble."
"What senior brother said is absolutely true."
Yunding stopped joking and agreed.
"The sudden appearance of the demons near the sect is no accident. With the explosion of geniuses this year, I have a feeling that something big will happen in the future. You and I had better make plans in advance."
The matchmaker knows the art of calculation.
Instinctively, capturing a corner of the future.
Several people looked at each other.
This is also the idea.
If anyone knew that there were disciples of the Luo Xian Sect possessing top-grade spiritual roots, it would probably lead to disaster.
Facing those super sects, Luo Xian Sect is probably not as powerful as Yifeng.
"Now that Senior Nephew Zheng Tuo has joined Senior Brother Wudao, he can escape without making any noise."
Yun Qianli also had the same idea.
"Zheng Tuo." Yunyangzi said solemnly: "I guess you are also a smart person. The best spiritual roots are rare in the world. If a thief finds out, your life will be in danger. Therefore, when you fail to reach Nascent Soul, you must not expose the top spiritual roots. Can you do it?"
"Disciple understands."
Needless to say, Zheng Tuo had already had this idea.
If he hadn't been weak enough, he might have forced several people present to swear a poisonous oath not to reveal the matter.
"Let's break up."
Yunyangzi waved.
Yunding, Yun Qianli, Matchmaker, Lei Xing, the four of them left.
Wu Dao wants to take Zheng Tuo away.
"Master, wait!"
Zheng Tuo stopped Wu Dao and looked at Yunyangzi.
"My... Sect Master, you seem to have said that if I can break the bronze mirror, you can give it to me, right?"
